about: A REAL response captured from the FASALYTICS historical market API (sanitized: shortened only). Not a synthetic fixture.

meta.notice: Historical records loaded from static files. They are not live or current market data, and nothing here is a forecast.
meta.unit_note: Prices are assumed to be INR per quintal (unit_basis "assumed_from_documentation"); the source file states no unit.

geography_reference.note: A third-party mirror of the Local Government Directory as of December 2022. It is not a verified current registry.

meta.market_verification: Market identities are created from source labels. No authoritative market list exists, so every market is "unverified".
meta.scope: Each mandi's own latest available observation of the requested commodity in the historical files. Mandis with no observation of that commodity are absent; nothing is taken from state-level or national data.
meta.ordering: mandi name, then id. This is alphabetical, not a ranking by price, date or anything else.
meta.tie_break: When a mandi has several rows on its latest date (varieties, grades) one is returned, chosen price-neutrally by variety label, then grade, then id; observations_on_latest_date gives the number of rows that date has.
meta.date_semantics: observed_date (= latest_observation_date) is the date in the source file. requested_at is when this request was served. They are unrelated.
meta.reference_date_definition: The newest observation date among the mandis matching the requested commodity and filters, in the historical files. It is not today and not a live feed.
